svg.title: Tension and compression of a rod
svg.desc: Two equal opposing axial forces stretch a rod in tension and shorten an identical rod in compression. Dotted outlines show the original top at length L₀. The change ΔL has equal magnitude for small elastic deformations under the same force magnitude. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Small elastic strains under tension and compression
Deformation is exaggerated; the original gray outline marks the unloaded length.
